title: Paeonia lactiflora tincture for medicinal use
intro: Paeonia lactiflora tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made by soaking the roots of the peony plant in alcohol, which extracts its active compounds. It is commonly used in herbalism for its purported ability to support cardiovascular health and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The tincture is believed to help regulate blood pressure and reduce hot flashes due to its phytoestrogen content. It is typically taken in small doses and is often recommended for its calming and adaptogenic properties. This preparation has been used historically in traditional Chinese medicine and continues to be valued in modern herbal practices.
